{"consolidated_memory":"## Truncated Documents in search/indexer/chunker.ts - Multiple Incidents

File: search/indexer/chunker.ts (search side)
Stack: TypeScript
Test coverage: search/indexer/chunker.test.ts
Common repro: index the long changelog fixture
Common signal: chunk offsets that stop short of the document length

### OCCASION 1: [2026-01-25] Non-ASCII Names
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #1910 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1
- Result: p99 latency fell from 8.9 s to 20 ms

### OCCASION 2: [2026-02-14] Midnight Boundary Jobs
- Trigger: jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #3285 on branch fix/truncated-documents-2
- Result: throughput rose 26 percent, to 925 requests per second

### OCCASION 3: [2026-07-02] Large Payloads
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #3574 on branch fix/truncated-documents-3
- Result: the backlog cleared 72 minutes after the deploy

### OCCASION 4: [2026-07-17] OAuth Sessions
- Trigger: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #6037 on branch fix/truncated-documents-4
- Result: the flaky test went from 67 failures per hundred runs to zero"}
